categories.title: To Infinity and Beyond Again
categories.intro: Our film category is the Toy Story sequels. Two, three, and four. [chuckles] Andy grew up, but we never did.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 4, Bonnie builds this new friend out of a spork, pipe cleaners, and googly eyes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Forky! [laughs] He insists he's TRASH. Honestly, the most relatable toy in the franchise.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 3, the toys get donated to this daycare, which turns out to be a toy prison.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sunnyside Daycare! It sounds so cheerful. [whispers] It is NOT cheerful. Ask the Caterpillar Room survivors.

clues.clue: Keanu Reeves voices this Canadian motorcycle stunt toy in Toy Story 4.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Duke Caboom! [excited] Yes I CAN-ada! He's Canada's greatest stuntman. Mostly because he never actually lands the jump.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, the still-in-the-box prospector who wants to go to a museum in Japan is known by this nickname.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Stinky Pete! [sarcastic] Shocking, a guy who never left his box turned out to be bitter. Kelsey Grammer voiced him, by the way.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 3, Lotso turns villain after being lost by this girl, who then replaced him with a new bear.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Daisy! [sighs] She lost Lotso, Big Baby, and Chuckles at a rest stop. Emily, by the way, was Jessie's girl. Not the Rick Springfield one.

categories.title: Back for Seconds
categories.intro: [mischievously] If at first you succeed... make another one. These are clues about Disney and Pixar sequels.

clues.clue: In Frozen II, a mysterious voice calls Elsa away, and she sings that she is going Into the this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Unknown! [laughs] Ahhh-ahhh, ahhh-ahhh. You hear it now. Sorry, it lives in your head forever.

clues.clue: In Finding Dory, Dory searches for her parents at the Marine Life Institute in this U.S. state.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is California! The institute is in Morro Bay. [chuckles] Unforgettable. Like Dory. Wait, no.

clues.clue: In Incredibles 2, this Parr family member becomes the face of the superhero comeback while Bob stays home with the kids.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Elastigirl! And Bob discovers that new math is harder than fighting supervillains. [sighs] Math is math, Bob.

clues.clue: In the prequel Monsters University, Mike and Sulley join this fraternity of misfits to compete in the Scare Games.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Oozma Kappa! O K, get it? [laughs] They were not okay at first. But they got there.

clues.clue: Released in 1994, this Aladdin follow-up was Disney's first direct-to-video animated sequel.
choices: Aladdin and the King of Thieves
The Lion King II: Simba's Pride
Pocahontas II: Journey to a New World
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Return of Jafar! [dramatic pause] It sold millions of tapes and kicked off a whole decade of straight-to-VHS sequels. For better... or worse.

categories.title: Spun Off to the Parks
categories.intro: Sometimes a movie gets a land. Sometimes a ride gets a MOVIE. [chuckles] It's spinoffs, theme park style.

clues.clue: Hop aboard a giant toy dog on Slinky Dog Dash in this land at Disney's Hollywood Studios.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Toy Story Land! [excited] You're shrunk down to toy size in Andy's backyard. Watch out for the giant popsicle sticks.

clues.clue: Radiator Springs Racers is the headliner of Cars Land in this park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney California Adventure! The Cadillac Range mountains look INCREDIBLE at sunset. [whispers] Ride it at night. Trust me.

clues.clue: This classic boat ride inspired a 2003 movie that spawned four sequels.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pirates of the Caribbean! [mischievously] Yo ho, a ride became a five movie franchise. Captain Jack would call that a very good haul.

clues.clue: Dwayne Johnson and Emily Blunt starred in this 2021 film based on a skipper-guided boat ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jungle Cruise! [laughs] And yes, the movie has as many puns as the real skippers. Which is a LOT.

clues.clue: Steve Guttenberg and Kirsten Dunst starred in this 1997 TV movie based on a Disney attraction.
accept: the twilight zone tower of terror
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tower of Terror! [gasps] It aired on The Wonderful World of Disney, before Eddie Murphy's Haunted Mansion movie was even an idea.

categories.title: Spinoff City
categories.intro: The fans voted for TV and spinoffs. Movies that got their own shows, and shows that got their own movies. [excited] Here we go!

clues.clue: This 2022 Pixar film is the movie Andy saw that made him want his very own space ranger toy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lightyear! [chuckles] It's a movie inside a movie inside a franchise. Inception, but make it Pixar.

clues.clue: This 2013 spinoff takes the world of Cars into the sky with a crop duster named Dusty.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Planes! [laughs] It was originally planned as a direct-to-video movie before landing in theaters. Get it? Landing. I'll stop.

clues.clue: A meerkat and a warthog from The Lion King got their own 1995 TV series with this title.
accept: the lion king's timon and pumbaa
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Timon and Pumbaa! [sighs] Hakuna matata. No worries, just years of globe-trotting and grubs. What a life.

clues.clue: Rapunzel's adventures continued in this 2017 Disney Channel series, later renamed Rapunzel's Tangled Adventure.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tangled: The Series! [excited] Tangled Ever After is the short with the runaway wedding rings. Close, but no frying pan.

clues.clue: Launchpad McQuack first flew into this series, before teaming up with Darkwing Duck in his own spinoff.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is DuckTales! Woo-oo! [laughs] Launchpad has crashed nearly every aircraft he has ever touched. Good thing he never flew ME anywhere.
